C-PHASE-RULE-PIN.Summary: Reconcile the plan skill's MustPassCommand restriction with the contract the linter actually enforces, and close the detector's implicit-current gap. One sentence, two sides: narrow skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md command_phase_rules so it names current-mode ngrace lint in a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand, and tighten assertion.phase-incompatible-command so an omitted --assertions (default current) matches the same way an explicit --assertions current already does. Command text only. Packaged skill mirror in lockstep.

Two defects, one sentence.
Prose. skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md command_phase_rules MustPassCommand bullet currently forbids ngrace lint, ngrace status, or another GRACE lifecycle command inside MustPassCommand. The linter never checks that sentence.
Code. validateAssertionPhase in src/artifact/assertions.ts matches only a regex for a literal --assertions current on a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand value. Its own message and src/lint/catalog.ts assertion.phase-incompatible-command name phase staleness: current mode evaluates active approved baselines and cannot serve as target or final evidence after writes begin. Default assertion mode is current (CLI: src/grace-lint.ts resolveAssertionMode fallback and the lint command's assertions default; library: src/lint/core.ts createResult and the evaluate-loop fallback). So bun run ngrace lint --path . in TargetAssertions is the named hazard and does not match.

Goals.Goal: Replace only the MustPassCommand bullet inside command_phase_rules in skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md so the prose names the enforced contract: do not put current-mode ngrace lint in a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand. Current-mode means the command text contains --assertions current, or it invokes ngrace lint (including bun run ngrace lint and src/grace.ts lint) and omits --assertions. The restriction matches command text; it does not resolve bun run <script> through package.json. Keep the opening leaf-project-evidence sentence. Leave the rest of the file, including the following --assertions current task-verification bullet, in place except where that bullet would contradict the new sentence.
Any edit to skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md is mirrored byte-for-byte to plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md. validate-marketplace fails otherwise.

Tighten validateAssertionPhase in src/artifact/assertions.ts so assertion.phase-incompatible-command fires on TargetAssertions MustPassCommand values whose command text is current-mode ngrace lint, whether --assertions current is explicit or omitted. Keep the diagnostic on TargetAssertions MustPassCommand only.

Update the diagnostic message and the src/lint/catalog.ts assertion.phase-incompatible-command explanation so both name omitted --assertions as current mode. Keep the phrase leaf project evidence in the message; src/grace-lint.test.ts asserts it.
